crossRefs.note: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

translations.web: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.
translations.bsb: The same thing happened to the second and third brothers, down to the seventh.
translations.kjv: Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
translations.asv: in like manner the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.
